name: Dr. Marc Halpern
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov health rule (ayurvedacollege.com, read 12 Nov 2026): his work is still mainly clinical medical training. The California College of Ayurveda he leads trains Ayurvedic Health Counselors, Clinical and Medical Ayurvedic Specialists, nurses and pre-med students (clinician trainings, always out), runs clinical consultations and sells medicated oils and supplements; his own short video courses include diabetes prevention and management, managing depression, managing anxiety and strengthening the immune system with Ayurveda (condition treatment). The college's yoga nidra teacher training is led by another teacher (Dr. Andrea Deerheart). What would pass is a few short recorded talks of his (Ayurveda and Zen, Living and Loving Through the Heart, Ayurvedic Philosophy of Health) on a shared course page; owner may want to revisit if a contemplative-only listing is wanted.
